sourceWindows: CURRENT / PC MUSIC: https://pitchfork.com/reviews/albums/grrl-beetle — GRRL's March 2026 Beetle window was screened; Moire was retained from its exact not-quite-4/4 but predictable rhythmic foundation.
CURRENT / DREAM JUKE: https://pitchfork.com/reviews/albums/nondi-nondi — Nondi_'s March 2026 album window was screened; I Version Melody was retained from the exact triplet-chirp juke-rhythm account.
ADJACENT / OPTIMO MUSIC: https://ra.co/reviews/24568 — Bergsonist's Middle Ouest window was screened; the title track was retained from its exact loose collage of shifting percussion.
OVERLOOKED / TIKITA: https://ra.co/reviews/15496 — Ko-Ta's remastered Festimask window was screened; Comptine was retained from its exact tightly knotted syncopated-percussion construction.
OVERLOOKED / COCOON: https://ra.co/reviews/14893 — Julien Bracht's Sub Collapsed window was screened; the title track was retained from its exact swung and shifting-percussion description.

ADDITIONAL WINDOWS: current September 2026 electronic coverage, GRRL's 24-track Beetle sequence, Nondi_'s album sequence, Ploy, Barac, Marcello Napoletano and adjacent RA catalogue searches were screened. Runs 83–84 sources and every previously retained exact identity were excluded.
explorationReceipt.approximateInspectedScope: Approximately 41 named tracks and releases across current, adjacent/emerging and overlooked catalogue windows; metadata and attributed descriptions only, with zero audio auditions.
exclusions: All canonical identities, active placement-specific rejects, untriggered PARKED revisits and previously retained exact identities were excluded.
The two protected internal handoffs remain unavailable; every other boundary remains available.
Ploy's 2025 window was screened but not ranked because it had already appeared in earlier exploration coverage; catalogue neighbours without exact-track rhythmic evidence stayed below the list.
No lead was promoted for recency, reputation, genre, novelty or technical cleverness.
Energy, density, space, hypnosis, emotional effect, phrase structure, perceived pulse and mixability remain unknown.
rankedLeadSummary: 1. GRRL — Moire: strongest current exact rhythm that is neither straight 4/4 nor formless.
2. Ko-Ta — Comptine: strongest overlooked exact syncopated-percussion construction.
3. Bergsonist — Middle Ouest: strongest shifting-percussion collage in a techno/house catalogue.
4. Nondi_ — I Version Melody: strongest current adjacent triplet-based juke-rhythm lead.
5. Julien Bracht — Sub Collapsed: strongest overlooked swung techno with shifting percussion.
